title: International Podcast Day and the voices that keep us company
dek: September 30 is International Podcast Day, a good excuse to thank the podcasts that fill our commutes, chores and quiet nights.
body: It is officially September 30, which makes it International Podcast Day. The event started in 2014 as National Podcast Day and was renamed International Podcast Day the next year, with the goal of promoting podcasting around the world.

For a lot of people, podcasts have quietly become a steady part of the day. They often start as something to listen to on long drives. Then they turn into company while folding laundry, washing dishes, taking a walk, and sometimes winding down at night.

Part of the appeal is how personal they feel. A good host sounds like a friend telling you about something they care about. Many well-loved shows are made by one or two people with a microphone and a lot of curiosity, and that kind of independent work deserves some thanks.

There is also something nice about a medium that lets your eyes rest. After a day of screens, you can close the laptop, put on an episode, and let someone else do the talking while you look out the window.
If a podcast has made your week better, take a minute today to leave it a rating or send an episode to a friend. It costs nothing and helps the people who make it keep going.
